content: The Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center School of Pharmacy, located at the Abilene Campus, officially commenced operations on August 12, 2007. At the time of its opening, the initial enrollment consisted of 40 students. This number is projected to increase to 160 students by the fall semester of 2011. Additionally, by that time, the institution anticipates employing a total of 40 professors and staff members to support its academic and operational needs. The Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center School of Pharmacy at the Abilene Campus offers a single professional degree program. This program confers the Doctorate of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) degree, which is designed to prepare students for advanced roles in the field of pharmacy.
